description: This file defines a C# class for an Orleans grain implementing a stateless worker with interleaving capabilities, including methods for fast and slow callbacks.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerWithMayInterleaveGrain
classes.description: A stateless Orleans grain that supports interleaving, with methods for fast and slow callback handling.

methods.name: MayInterleaveMethod
methods.description: Determines if the current request can be interleaved based on the method name.

methods.name: GoSlow
methods.description: Handles a slow callback by waiting asynchronously.

methods.name: GoFast
methods.description: Handles a fast callback by waiting asynchronously.
